summary: Ran a citation-consistency check of both current interpretations against the retained observations and submitted two successor accounts correcting transcribed numbers. For the configuration-recovery account, the counterevidence now states the control's election as the receipt records it (19 polls of the harness's 5ms interval, about 95ms at receipt 9a373c13725a42aa9f48f59c0f2f2f1c event 6) instead of a figure taken from an earlier local construction run. For the replay-completion account, the two flag-off control latencies that had been swapped are attributed correctly (1ms at event 21 of receipt 3d04552f58e548b0ae089192392b564f; 5ms at event 21 and 0ms at event 25 of receipt e82594cc274340f0a961608cda519e00; 0ms at event 13 of receipt ebb3bb9fa26547f790129eea909d1d5a). Each successor names the correction at the head of its rationale and otherwise preserves sources, executions, knowledge uses, counterevidence, limitations and conclusions unchanged; both validate and append. Remaining unmeasured item: whether a default snapshot cadence and threshold reach the replay bound, which I will build next.
